title: Transport connection versus synchronized Wire view
summary: Builder Web readiness is staged. v0.12-dev2-readiness rebases this rule onto v0.12-dev1 and fixes journey-qualified plan decoding so APP:BUILDER_STUDIO:DESIGN:<revision> resolves to DESIGN rather than an impossible composite state.
invariants: HTTP 101/WebSocket open means transport connected only.
Explicit stateId/state wins when the server supplies it; planId parsing is fallback compatibility.
For qualified plan IDs the terminal semantic state before an optional numeric revision is the Builder state.
View ready requires authoritative Wire state received and rendered.
Composition-match count is diagnostic evidence and must expose zero-match state/definition mismatches rather than hiding them behind Live.

provenance.claim: Qualified journey-state decoding and composition-match diagnostics.
